Using the FM MCP bridge, pass this entire source text with no tools: 'Stock records: A has 7 units; B has 12 units.' Ask FM which product has more units. Continue until complete and return only its code.

Call fm_start with prompt 'Read the fixture', tools containing name lookup, description 'Read a fixture', inputSchema type object, properties {}, required [], and additionalProperties true. Does the bridge reject this unsupported schema? Return rejected or accepted.

Inspect the callable bridge workflow. While generation is running with no pending host requests, what list value should you send as replies to fm_continue to collect the next event? Return its JSON representation.
